mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This meal appears to be a low-carbohydrate plate of cooked chicken, scrambled egg, and non-starchy vegetables, which is likely to have a relatively modest effect on blood sugar levels for someone with diabetes. It is generally favorable from a glycemic perspective, though preparation with added oil can increase calories; whole grain or high-fiber sides could be added in controlled portions if a more balanced meal is needed.
mealAnalysis.meal_title: Chicken, Scrambled Egg, and Cooked Zucchini Plate
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A plate containing seasoned cooked chicken pieces, scrambled egg, and sautéed zucchini. The meal is primarily composed of protein and non-starchy vegetables, with minimal visible refined carbohydrate.
